lead.headline: Safety claims need independent proof
lead.summary: GAO independent controlled tests publicly released on 18 November, UK parliament's 18 November oversight recommendations, and California Waymo freeway restrictions effective 11 November all underscore the need for verifiable safeguards and human intervention.

stories.title: GAO audit tests historical chatbot safeguards
stories.summary: Four selected AI platforms under controlled spring 2026 scenarios; public release 18 Nov; does not establish actual attacks or failure rates for current model versions.

stories.title: UK committee recommends enforceable assurance
stories.summary: 18 Nov report identified ten gaps and proposed a new Bill and independent regulator; recommendations, not enacted legal requirements.

stories.title: California restricts Waymo freeway operating domain
stories.summary: Restriction effective 11 Nov following construction closure concerns; reported 17–19 Nov. Company says recent incidents involved no injuries or collisions. Original DMV order not obtained.

stories.title: Qwen4-Max safety changes remain vendor claims
stories.summary: Reuters 16 Nov reported security-safety upgrades and noted claims were not independently verified.

stories.title: Human-agency continuity: UK facial-search
stories.summary: 12 Nov Home Office survey had 779 voluntary respondents, 34% misunderstanding or uncertainty on a threshold; not error rate and not a new event.
